findings.detail: Harvey Tool delayed-draw and revolver spreads are stored as 4.75%, but the current-period schedule states 4.50%; 4.75% appears only in the comparative schedule.
Packaging Coordinators revolver is stored as 4.50%, but the current-period schedule states 5.00%; 4.50% is the comparative-period value.

rationale: Class 1 repeated cell review. Six of eight flagged spreads match the current-period schedule. Harvey Tool delayed-draw and revolver are flagged at 4.75% while current-period table 16 rows 6-7 state 4.50%; comparative table 26 rows 45-46 state 4.75%. Packaging Coordinators revolver is flagged at 4.50% while current-period table 15 row 42 states 5.00%; comparative table 26 row 33 states 4.50%. This proves comparative-period leakage in three flagged positions. No aggregate anchor is applicable to spread cells.
